_comment: User-authored template strings, rendered against placeholders drawn
from this file's CONFIG_BLOCK (any '; key = value' resolved setting
OrcaSlicer writes -- not a fixed list) plus a small set of computed
placeholders such as total_number_toolchanges. Basic arithmetic,
comparisons, a ternary (cond ? a : b), a `let name = expr` assignment
(computes once, reusable by every {...} block after it in the SAME
template only -- see render_template()'s docstring), and helper
functions like time_format(seconds) are supported inside {...} -- see
post_processors/helpers/placeholders.py for the full expression
grammar and the up-to-date placeholder/function list.
Each template independently targets one or more destinations:
'notice'        -- shown as a plain console message on the printer.
'gcode_comment' -- inserted as a plain comment line near the top
of the file, metadata only, nothing printer-side.
'abort'         -- refuses the print (Klipper's action_raise_error,
the SAME mechanism dock_collision_guard.py uses).
Always shown on the console regardless of this
processor's own 'notice': {"display": ...} setting.
Each template also accepts an optional 'condition': a boolean {expr}
(same grammar, no braces, e.g. "curr_bed_type != 'High Temp Plate'")
gating the WHOLE template -- every destination above only fires when
it evaluates true. Missing/blank = always fires (the old behavior).
A condition that fails to evaluate is treated as false (never fires)
and emits its own 'warning' notice instead -- see evaluate_condition()
in helpers/placeholders.py. This is what makes 'abort' safe to use for
a 'watch a placeholder, refuse to print if it's wrong' check: pair it
with a condition and it stays silent on every normal print.
Empty templates list = this processor does nothing at all.
_templates: The list of configured templates. Each entry: name (used as the NOTICE title / gcode-comment prefix), text (the template string, {expr} placeholders), condition (optional, gates the whole template -- see _comment above), destinations (list of 'notice'/'gcode_comment'/'abort').
